mapper.sql: select stat_id, course_id, semester_id, class_id, total_students, max_score, min_score, avg_score, pass_count, fail_count, pass_rate, excellent_count, excellent_rate, status, stat_time, batch_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from aem_grade_statistics
mapper.insert:
insert into aem_grade_statistics
course_id, semester_id, class_id, total_students, max_score, min_score, avg_score, pass_count, fail_count, pass_rate, excellent_count, excellent_rate, status, stat_time, batch_no, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{courseId}, #{semesterId}, #{classId}, #{totalStudents}, #{maxScore}, #{minScore}, #{avgScore}, #{passCount}, #{failCount}, #{passRate}, #{excellentCount}, #{excellentRate}, #{status}, #{statTime}, #{batchNo}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark},
mapper.delete: delete from aem_grade_statistics where stat_id in #{statId}
mapper.select: where course_id = #{courseId} and semester_id = #{semesterId} and (class_id is null or class_id = 0) limit 1

select count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(max(total_score),0) as maxScore, coalesce(min(total_score),0) as minScore, coalesce(round(avg(total_score),2),0) as avgScore, sum(case when total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as excellentCount, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) / count(1) * 100, 2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) / count(1) * 100, 2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record where course_id = #{courseId} and semester_id = #{semesterId} and total_score is not null and status = '0'

select course_id as courseId, count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(max(total_score),0) as maxScore, coalesce(min(total_score),0) as minScore, coalesce(round(avg(total_score),2),0) as avgScore, sum(case when total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as excellentCount, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) / count(1) * 100, 2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) / count(1) * 100, 2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record where semester_id = #{semesterId} and total_score is not null and status = '0' group by course_id

select sum(case when total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when total_score >= 60 and total_score < 70 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when total_score >= 70 and total_score < 80 then 1 else 0 end) as mediumCount, sum(case when total_score >= 80 and total_score < 90 then 1 else 0 end) as goodCount, sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as excellentCount from aem_grade_record where course_id = #{courseId} and semester_id = #{semesterId} and total_score is not null and status = '0'

select count(distinct course_id) as courseCount, count(1) as totalRecords, count(distinct student_id) as studentCount, coalesce(round(avg(total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record where semester_id = #{semesterId} and total_score is not null and status = '0'

select r.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, cl.class_name as className, r.total_score as totalScore, r.grade_point as gradePoint, r.grade_level as gradeLevel, r.is_pass as isPass from aem_grade_record r left join sam_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join brm_class cl on cl.class_id = s.class_id where r.course_id = #{courseId} and r.semester_id = #{semesterId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' order by r.total_score desc, r.student_id asc

select s.class_id as classId, cl.class_name as className, count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(max(r.total_score),0) as maxScore, coalesce(min(r.total_score),0) as minScore, sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record r join sam_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join brm_class cl on cl.class_id = s.class_id where r.semester_id = #{semesterId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' and r.course_id = #{courseId} group by s.class_id, cl.class_name order by passRate desc, avgScore desc

select t.teacher_id as teacherId, t.teacher_name as teacherName, t.teacher_code as teacherCode, d.dept_name as deptName, count(distinct r.course_id) as courseCount, count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as passCount, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record r join (select distinct course_id, teacher_id from tpm_course_offering where del_flag = '0' and semester_id = #{semesterId} and teacher_id is not null) o on o.course_id = r.course_id join brm_teacher t on t.teacher_id = o.teacher_id left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = t.dept_id where r.semester_id = #{semesterId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' group by t.teacher_id, t.teacher_name, t.teacher_code, d.dept_name order by passRate desc, avgScore desc

select s.major_id as majorId, mj.major_name as majorName, count(distinct r.student_id) as studentCount, count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, sum(case when r.total_score < 60 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record r join sam_student s on s.student_id = r.student_id left join brm_major mj on mj.major_id = s.major_id where r.semester_id = #{semesterId} and r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' group by s.major_id, mj.major_name order by passRate desc, avgScore desc

select r.semester_id as semesterId, sm.semester_name as semesterName, count(1) as totalStudents, coalesce(round(avg(r.total_score),2),0) as avgScore, coalesce(round(avg(r.grade_point),2),0) as avgGpa, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 60 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as passRate, coalesce(round(sum(case when r.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end)/count(1)*100,2),0) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record r left join brm_semester sm on sm.semester_id = r.semester_id where r.total_score is not null and r.status = '0' and r.course_id = #{courseId} group by r.semester_id, sm.semester_name order by r.semester_id asc
